title: Reject a dependency that closes a cycle
preconditions: Create storage, query and viewer work items; persist storage→query progress_done and query→viewer merge_integrated dependencies.

steps.action: Attempt viewer→storage progress_done dependency with ID cycle.
Reload the plan and inspect the attempted destination.

expected_result: A rejected cycle cannot leak into the persisted plan.
